summary: Iter 58 v2 verified end-to-end. All P0 acceptance criteria PASS on the deployed preview: (1) Full booking happy path via UI as customer@booktalent.com finishes at step 6 with data-testid=step-success visible, booking-ref pill 'BT-260727-958E01' and 'Booking Confirmed!' heading — URL stays on /book/... with ZERO 401s and NO redirect to /login. (2) Cookies cleared mid-flow between step 4 and 5 then clicking Pay produces the friendly toast 'Your session has expired. Please refresh the page and sign in again.' and URL stays on /book/... (no auto-redirect anywhere). (3) Anonymous visit to / triggers /api/auth/me 401 but the landing page renders with no session-expired toast and no redirect. (4) Backend regression pytest 5/5 pass (test_iter58_booking_payment.py) — POST /bookings → /payments/init → /payments/verify with mock_otp=123456 returns 200 with status=pending_artist and payment_status=token_paid. The customer_travel_allowance='' -> 422 blocker reported in iter 58 v1 has been correctly fixed in BookingFlow.jsx (line 314-322): explicit payload builder coerces empty string to 0 before POST /bookings.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js (iter58 v2): interceptor is now message-rewrite-only — no dispatchEvent, no window.location. This is the right minimal fix; component-level catch blocks + Protected in App.js handle all real redirects. Verified zero 401s trigger any nav.
auth.jsx: bt:session-expired handler removed cleanly; only /auth/me probe + login/register/logout remain. useMemo on context value avoids re-render fanout.

BookingFlow.jsx line 314-322: explicit payload with Number coercion for customer_travel_allowance is the correct fix. Consider also whitelisting fields instead of ...form to avoid future silent 422s from other empty-string fields.
auth.jsx line 30 localStorage.removeItem inside try/catch — good defensive coding for storage-disabled browsers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 iter-58 v2 acceptance criteria fully green: happy path, cookie-eviction friendly toast without redirect, anonymous landing without redirect)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 58 v2 is fully verified. Both the P0 bug (Pay redirects to /login) and the iter 58 v1 regression (aggressive interceptor pulling users off booking on transient 401s) are resolved. The customer_travel_allowance=''→422 bug flagged in iter 58 v1 report is also fixed via explicit payload coercion in BookingFlow.jsx. All future iterations can trust /app/backend/tests/test_iter58_booking_payment.py as the anchor regression for booking+payment.
rca of the issue: Original P0: axios interceptor in api.js (iter 58 v1) dispatched a bt:session-expired event on EVERY 401, and AuthProvider hard-redirected via window.location.href to /login?returnTo=... after 800ms. Background probes (/auth/me, /notifications) that transiently 401 during the booking flow yanked the user off the payment page. Iter 58 v2 fix: kept ONLY the response-detail message rewrite in the interceptor; removed the event dispatch AND the session-expired listener in auth.jsx. Route-level Protected in App.js still catches genuinely anonymous users when useAuth().user is null. Additionally, the tail-end 422 bug (BookingFlow spreading form.customer_travel_allowance='' into POST /bookings) was fixed with an explicit payload builder that coerces the field to Number|0. Net verified behaviour: authenticated user completes booking without any interceptor-induced navigation; transient/background 401s are silently rewritten but do NOT redirect; only a genuine session loss surfaces the friendly toast when the user takes an authenticated action.
